name: guardrails
description: Safety and review of Claude's output. Five mods, each toggled in the plugin config. blast-radius: holds destructive shell commands (rm -rf, git push --force, git reset --hard, DROP TABLE...) behind a card showing the files at risk; pick Proceed or Cancel. secret-sentry: denies Write/Edit/NotebookEdit that would put API keys, tokens or private keys in a file (.env and *.example exempt). reflect: spots lasting corrections in your prompts (or 'remember: ...') and offers to save them to ./CLAUDE.md or ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; /reflect-queue, /reflect-pause. assumption-tracker: after each turn lists what Claude assumed; mark Right or Wrong and send a fix for the wrong ones; /assumptions. self-critique: /critique [auto|opus|sonnet|haiku] reviews Claude's last answer with a verdict, flaws and a Make this fix button.

blastRadius.title: blast-radius
blastRadius.description: Asks before destructive shell commands run

secretSentry.title: secret-sentry
secretSentry.description: Blocks API keys and private keys from being written into files

reflect.title: reflect
reflect.description: Spots corrections in your prompts and saves them as rules in CLAUDE.md

assumptionTracker.title: assumption-tracker
assumptionTracker.description: Lists the assumptions Claude made and sends fixes for the ones you mark wrong

selfCritique.title: self-critique
selfCritique.description: /critique panel that reviews Claude's last answer, with one-click fixes
